text_block_list.text: Summer camp has finally come to an<n>end...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer. After we get back home...

text_block_list.text:
Well, it has nothing to do with training,<n>but there's
something I want to do.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'll let you know when I'm<n>ready, so just be
prepared.

text_block_list.text: Our next race will begin as soon as<n>summer ends!
